svg.aria-label: The four kinds of files in this repository, drawn as 8-bit pixel art under a green LED sign reading FOUR KINDS OF FILES. Four panels: a purple Context panel holding strategy, brand, content, projects, memory and docs plus AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md; a green Agents panel holding agents, .agents/skills and integrations; an amber Data panel holding data and reports; and a blue Code panel holding scripts, playgrounds and .github/workflows.
